content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to reduce the use of digital outputs on a single [product_name], since these outputs are only being displayed on the [product_name] web interface. I want to free them up for other functionalities, so I tried replacing them with flags (M1, M2, etc.). However, when I do this, the web interface no longer shows them—only physical digital outputs (such as Q1, Q2) are visible as indicators. In summary, I am looking for a way to use flags as display indicators on the web page instead of digital outputs.
I'm not sure I completely understand your request. Could you please upload your [product_name] configuration file and the web project as a ZIP archive?

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters a limitation with [product_name] web editor: only digital outputs, not internal flags, can be used as indicators in the visualization. This limits efficient use of hardware outputs, which the user wants to reserve for more critical control tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects more flexibility in the web visualization, enabling the use of flags as indicators—allowing hardware digital outputs to be dedicated to control functions rather than purely for visualization.
